units.rawText: The backdoor installation was successful and Miss Persicaria successfully loaded her upgrade module. Now all we have to do is pinpoint the Professor's position... Hm? Anna?
units.displayText: The backdoor installation was successful and Miss Persicaria successfully loaded her upgrade module. Now all we have to do is pinpoint the Professor's position... Hm? Anna?

spans.text: The backdoor installation was successful and Miss Persicaria successfully loaded her upgrade module. Now all we have to do is pinpoint the Professor's position... Hm? Anna?

units.rawText: Neumann turns around and sees Antonina with a grim look on her face.
units.displayText: Neumann turns around and sees Antonina with a grim look on her face.

spans.text: Neumann turns around and sees Antonina with a grim look on her face.

units.rawText: Anna, did you find something?
units.displayText: Anna, did you find something?

spans.text: Anna, did you find something?

units.rawText: Antonina doesn't answer Neumann right away. Instead, she brings up a string of code on the screen.
units.displayText: Antonina doesn't answer Neumann right away. Instead, she brings up a string of code on the screen.

spans.text: Antonina doesn't answer Neumann right away. Instead, she brings up a string of code on the screen.

units.rawText: Thanks to the data Persicaria sent back, I finally pinpointed that constantly-changing section of code... But...
units.displayText: Thanks to the data Persicaria sent back, I finally pinpointed that constantly-changing section of code... But...

spans.text: Thanks to the data Persicaria sent back, I finally pinpointed that constantly-changing section of code... But...

units.rawText: Hm... Is, is this... Is this neural cloud data? Does this code belong to Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Hm... Is, is this... Is this neural cloud data? Does this code belong to Eosphorus?

spans.text: Hm... Is, is this... Is this neural cloud data? Does this code belong to Eosphorus?

units.rawText: No, although the basic structure is similar. However, the exact specifications and parameters are distinctly different from the information we have on Eosphorus.
units.displayText: No, although the basic structure is similar. However, the exact specifications and parameters are distinctly different from the information we have on Eosphorus.

spans.text: No, although the basic structure is similar. However, the exact specifications and parameters are distinctly different from the information we have on Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Whew... And here I thought Eosphorus' consciousness was present in the fragment.
units.displayText: Whew... And here I thought Eosphorus' consciousness was present in the fragment.

spans.text: Whew... And here I thought Eosphorus' consciousness was present in the fragment.

units.rawText: If it really was in there, I'd put him through hell.
units.displayText: If it really was in there, I'd put him through hell.

spans.text: If it really was in there, I'd put him through hell.

units.rawText: Antonina finishes speaking through clenched teeth, then takes a deep breath before resuming her usual calm.
units.displayText: Antonina finishes speaking through clenched teeth, then takes a deep breath before resuming her usual calm.

spans.text: Antonina finishes speaking through clenched teeth, then takes a deep breath before resuming her usual calm.

units.rawText: However, the fact that this fragment of Eosphorus contains another neural cloud—perhaps even an abnormal neural cloud pattern—is very unusual.
units.displayText: However, the fact that this fragment of Eosphorus contains another neural cloud—perhaps even an abnormal neural cloud pattern—is very unusual.

spans.text: However, the fact that this fragment of Eosphorus contains another neural cloud—perhaps even an abnormal neural cloud pattern—is very unusual.

units.rawText: Also, this data... Part of it has merged with Eosphorus' code.
units.displayText: Also, this data... Part of it has merged with Eosphorus' code.

spans.text: Also, this data... Part of it has merged with Eosphorus' code.

units.rawText: While I'm not an expert in this field, I can tell that this neural cloud data is highly unstable. Most of its functions have gone dormant...
units.displayText: While I'm not an expert in this field, I can tell that this neural cloud data is highly unstable. Most of its functions have gone dormant...

spans.text: While I'm not an expert in this field, I can tell that this neural cloud data is highly unstable. Most of its functions have gone dormant...

units.rawText: If nothing is done, this neural cloud might well be consumed by Eosphorus' code or flagged as erroneous and outright deleted.
units.displayText: If nothing is done, this neural cloud might well be consumed by Eosphorus' code or flagged as erroneous and outright deleted.

spans.text: If nothing is done, this neural cloud might well be consumed by Eosphorus' code or flagged as erroneous and outright deleted.

units.rawText: ...Give me a hand, Neumann. I want to try something... I'm going to extract this stretch of code from Eosphorus' fragment and build it into a neural cloud pattern.
units.displayText: ...Give me a hand, Neumann. I want to try something... I'm going to extract this stretch of code from Eosphorus' fragment and build it into a neural cloud pattern.

spans.text: ...Give me a hand, Neumann. I want to try something... I'm going to extract this stretch of code from Eosphorus' fragment and build it into a neural cloud pattern.

units.rawText: Wait a minute. Are you planning to make contact with this unknown neural cloud? It's too dangerous.
units.displayText: Wait a minute. Are you planning to make contact with this unknown neural cloud? It's too dangerous.

spans.text: Wait a minute. Are you planning to make contact with this unknown neural cloud? It's too dangerous.

units.rawText: Antonina looks at the Professor and Persicaria, who are lying down in the testing bay.
units.displayText: Antonina looks at the Professor and Persicaria, who are lying down in the testing bay.

spans.text: Antonina looks at the Professor and Persicaria, who are lying down in the testing bay.

units.rawText: I always thought it was strange... Why couldn't Persicaria and I enter Eosphorus' fragment?
units.displayText: I always thought it was strange... Why couldn't Persicaria and I enter Eosphorus' fragment?

spans.text: I always thought it was strange... Why couldn't Persicaria and I enter Eosphorus' fragment?

units.rawText: Didn't we discuss this earlier? The Professor was the only one who could pass the Sanctifiers' defense programs because they were human.
units.displayText: Didn't we discuss this earlier? The Professor was the only one who could pass the Sanctifiers' defense programs because they were human.

spans.text: Didn't we discuss this earlier? The Professor was the only one who could pass the Sanctifiers' defense programs because they were human.

units.rawText: That was a conclusion based on the information we had and ruling out options which made no sense... Even if it was correct, there are still many things it does not explain.
units.displayText: That was a conclusion based on the information we had and ruling out options which made no sense... Even if it was correct, there are still many things it does not explain.

spans.text: That was a conclusion based on the information we had and ruling out options which made no sense... Even if it was correct, there are still many things it does not explain.

units.rawText: Why did the defense program not destroy my neural cloud and that of Persicaria's? Instead, it pushed us out of the fragment.
units.displayText: Why did the defense program not destroy my neural cloud and that of Persicaria's? Instead, it pushed us out of the fragment.

spans.text: Why did the defense program not destroy my neural cloud and that of Persicaria's? Instead, it pushed us out of the fragment.

units.rawText: Why is the Professor, who has access permissions, stuck in there and not responding?
units.displayText: Why is the Professor, who has access permissions, stuck in there and not responding?

spans.text: Why is the Professor, who has access permissions, stuck in there and not responding?

units.rawText: ...Indeed. It took a lot of work on our part to just barely help Persicaria infiltrate it.
units.displayText: ...Indeed. It took a lot of work on our part to just barely help Persicaria infiltrate it.

spans.text: ...Indeed. It took a lot of work on our part to just barely help Persicaria infiltrate it.

units.rawText: If someone was secretly helping the Professor...
units.displayText: If someone was secretly helping the Professor...

spans.text: If someone was secretly helping the Professor...

units.rawText: Well, if we want to know the answer, we have no choice but to make contact with this fragment!
units.displayText: Well, if we want to know the answer, we have no choice but to make contact with this fragment!

spans.text: Well, if we want to know the answer, we have no choice but to make contact with this fragment!

units.rawText: Even if it's only a 1% chance... I want to increase the odds of Persicaria and the Professor making it out alive.
units.displayText: Even if it's only a 1% chance... I want to increase the odds of Persicaria and the Professor making it out alive.

spans.text: Even if it's only a 1% chance... I want to increase the odds of Persicaria and the Professor making it out alive.

units.rawText: Are you sure you want to take this risk?
units.displayText: Are you sure you want to take this risk?

spans.text: Are you sure you want to take this risk?

units.rawText: (Sigh) Looks like they've influenced me, too.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Looks like they've influenced me, too.

spans.text: (Sigh) Looks like they've influenced me, too.

units.rawText: Antonina shakes her head with a self-deprecatory laugh.
units.displayText: Antonina shakes her head with a self-deprecatory laugh.

spans.text: Antonina shakes her head with a self-deprecatory laugh.

units.rawText: Neumann, start analyzing the differences between this neural cloud data and Eosphorus' neural cloud pattern. Time is tight, so we'll both start together.
units.displayText: Neumann, start analyzing the differences between this neural cloud data and Eosphorus' neural cloud pattern. Time is tight, so we'll both start together.

spans.text: Neumann, start analyzing the differences between this neural cloud data and Eosphorus' neural cloud pattern. Time is tight, so we'll both start together.

units.rawText: Understood. I'll begin with the portion that's entwined with the database.
units.displayText: Understood. I'll begin with the portion that's entwined with the database.

spans.text: Understood. I'll begin with the portion that's entwined with the database.

units.rawText: Please do.
units.displayText: Please do.

units.displayText: In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: A grandly dressed High-Order Entropic sits upon a throne with eyes closed, as though she were taking a nap.
units.displayText: A grandly dressed High-Order Entropic sits upon a throne with eyes closed, as though she were taking a nap.

spans.text: A grandly dressed High-Order Entropic sits upon a throne with eyes closed, as though she were taking a nap.

units.rawText: Suddenly, an eerie ripple spreads in all directions from the throne.
units.displayText: Suddenly, an eerie ripple spreads in all directions from the throne.

spans.text: Suddenly, an eerie ripple spreads in all directions from the throne.

units.rawText: <color=#FF7F50>Doing more pointless things again, oh gods?</color>
units.displayText: Doing more pointless things again, oh gods?

spans.text: Doing more pointless things again, oh gods?

units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic sitting on the throne glances scornfully toward the darkened sky.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic sitting on the throne glances scornfully toward the darkened sky.

units.rawText: <color=#FF7F50>The labyrinth, the heavens, us... What do you intend to change now?</color>
units.displayText: The labyrinth, the heavens, us... What do you intend to change now?

units.displayText: Ptolemaea.

spans.text: Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: Lady <color=#FF7F50>Malkira</color>... Our guests have taken the divine relic.
units.displayText: Lady Malkira... Our guests have taken the divine relic.

Malkira
... Our guests have taken the divine relic.

units.displayText: Hardly an issue. Has "he" accepted the invitation?

spans.text: Hardly an issue. Has "he" accepted the invitation?

units.rawText: I delivered the invitation as asked... But unfortunately, he does not seem willing to step onto the dance floor.
units.displayText: I delivered the invitation as asked... But unfortunately, he does not seem willing to step onto the dance floor.

spans.text: Not giving up, then... Still, this outcome was an expected one.

units.rawText: <color=#FF7F50>You've done very well, Ptolemaea.</color>
units.displayText: You've done very well, Ptolemaea.

spans.text: You've done very well, Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: I simply completed the duty I was assigned.
units.displayText: I simply completed the duty I was assigned.

units.displayText: Caina.

spans.text: Caina.

units.rawText: Lady Malkira! My mission is, uh, intact! No, wait, is it complete?
units.displayText: Lady Malkira! My mission is, uh, intact! No, wait, is it complete?

spans.text: Lady Malkira! My mission is, uh, intact! No, wait, is it complete?

units.rawText: Still~ no~ idea what Caina is saying~
units.displayText: Still~ no~ idea what Caina is saying~

spans.text: Still~ no~ idea what Caina is saying~

units.rawText: Urgh.... In any case, I did as Lady Malkira asked and caught them, chased them and beat them into crap!
units.displayText: Urgh.... In any case, I did as Lady Malkira asked and caught them, chased them and beat them into crap!

spans.text: Urgh.... In any case, I did as Lady Malkira asked and caught them, chased them and beat them into crap!

units.rawText: Hahahaha, they were loads of fun! Give me more missions like that, Lady Malkira!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, they were loads of fun! Give me more missions like that, Lady Malkira!

spans.text: Hahahaha, they were loads of fun! Give me more missions like that, Lady Malkira!

units.rawText: Did you beat them into scrap or into crap?
units.displayText: Did you beat them into scrap or into crap?

. Stop teasing Caina.

units.rawText: Hey, Jellyfish! It didn't turn out like you said! I followed your plan, but they ran off instead.
units.displayText: Hey, Jellyfish! It didn't turn out like you said! I followed your plan, but they ran off instead.

spans.text: Hey, Jellyfish! It didn't turn out like you said! I followed your plan, but they ran off instead.

units.rawText: I have no idea who is this "Jellyfish" you're addressing... But I can tell you that Antenora was the one who gave you that plan.
units.displayText: I have no idea who is this "Jellyfish" you're addressing... But I can tell you that Antenora was the one who gave you that plan.

spans.text: I have no idea who is this "Jellyfish" you're addressing... But I can tell you that Antenora was the one who gave you that plan.

units.rawText: So it was Spider... Oi, Spider! It didn't turn out like you said! You told me that they'd fight me seriously if I attacked the most badly hurt one of them!
units.displayText: So it was Spider... Oi, Spider! It didn't turn out like you said! You told me that they'd fight me seriously if I attacked the most badly hurt one of them!

spans.text: So it was Spider... Oi, Spider! It didn't turn out like you said! You told me that they'd fight me seriously if I attacked the most badly hurt one of them!

units.rawText: Firstly, I am not a spider. Secondly, didn't you get a big fight with that Sanctifier like you wanted?
units.displayText: Firstly, I am not a spider. Secondly, didn't you get a big fight with that Sanctifier like you wanted?

spans.text: Firstly, I am not a spider. Secondly, didn't you get a big fight with that Sanctifier like you wanted?

units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic called Antenora laughs. There is a hint of mockery to it.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic called Antenora laughs. There is a hint of mockery to it.

units.rawText: But they ran off in the end! Those guys... All they know how to do is run. And Lady Malkira wouldn't let me keep chasing them...

units.displayText: Yes, Lady Malkira!

units.displayText: Caina looks a little apprehensive as Malkira addresses her.

units.displayText: Ehehehe...

units.rawText: <color=#FF7F50>No matter how much time passes, the Sanctifiers still have not realized that everything they do has been in vain, only repeating the mistakes of the past...</color>

units.displayText: Silence... Lady Malkira, we...

units.rawText: <color=#FF7F50>If their targets are the three Sanctifier Watchtowers, then we shall follow the script they expect and play out a show to please the gods.</color>
